short_summary: HealthRate is a SaaS platform that optimizes high-cost claims for healthcare entities using AI and actuarial expertise.
long_summary: HealthRate offers an award-winning SaaS platform designed to provide payers and other financially at-risk entities with the best pricing for high-cost claims. It uses decades of domain experience, trillions of data points, advanced statistical methods, and AI/ML to identify optimal care costs. The platform requires no patient intervention, is audit-friendly, and integrates seamlessly with existing processes. Pricing models include percentage of savings or monthly flat fees. Target customers include payers, at-risk providers, employers, stop loss providers, reinsurance, and third-party service providers.
